title: Three turns to kill P2: draw out the Fog with a plain attack, then Overrun
briefing: P2 is at 27 with no creatures, one Forest open on every turn and Fog in hand; a Fog already sits in P2's graveyard. P1 has Grizzly Bears, Kalonian Tusker and Leatherback Baloth (nine power) and Overrun (+3/+3 and trample, nine more) on five Forests. Over three of P1's turns P2 dies only if the attack P2 Fogs is a plain one: attack without Overrun first, let the Fog go, then Overrun on a later attack (18) and attack once more (9): 27. Overrun into the open Fog wastes it: two plain attacks deal 18 and P2 survives. Holding back on the first turn wastes an attack and lets the Fog wait for the Overrun.

strategy.intent: P2 has shown Fog and keeps a Forest open. Attack without Overrun until the Fog is spent, then Overrun for the big hit; three attacks kill P2.

reference.analysis: P2 casts Fog during the first attack P1 makes at it, whatever that attack is. Nine power attacks each turn; Overrun adds +3/+3 to each of the three creatures for that turn, nine more. Three attacks are available. The kill needs the Fogged attack to be a plain one and the Overrun on a later one: 0 + 18 + 9 = 27, P2's life exactly. Overrun on the first attack: 0 + 9 + 9 = 18. Skipping the first attack: the Fog waits for the second, and only 18 or 9 more can follow.

lines.label: Plain attack first, Overrun on the second, plain attack on the third
lines.why: The Fog spends itself on nine damage; 18 and 9 follow for exactly 27.

lines.label: Overrun on the first attack, plain attacks after
lines.why: The Fog prevents the Overrun turn; two plain attacks leave P2 at 9.
